name: Rip
description: Finishing move that causes damage over time.  Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:   1 point  : [6 * 1 * (7)] damage over 12 sec.   2 points: [6 * 1 * (11)] damage over 12 sec.   3 points: [6 * 1 * (15)] damage over 12 sec.   4 points: [6 * 1 * (19)] damage over 12 sec.   5 points: [6 * 1 * (23)] damage over 12 sec.
